verdict.rationale: Vestd documents a 409A valuation service for UK companies issuing options to US taxpayers, sold "for a small fee" (vestd-docs-16), and has a dedicated share valuation page (vestd-docs-28), so the core ordering of a 409A from Vestd is evidenced. Nothing shows the valuation is generated from live cap table data, described as audit-ready, or refreshed on a schedule. missing for 10: evidence of an in-platform ordering workflow, generation from live cap table data, audit-ready/safe-harbor documentation, scheduled refresh valuations, independent corroboration.
